text: Good morning, Ashley and Todd. After a few days without strikes, the relative calm in the region
has been broken with this latest exchange. CENTCOM says U.S. and Saudi fighter aircraft struck
multiple terrorist logistics and weapons sites across eastern Iraq in a strong response to over
30 IRGC-directed aerial drone attacks in the last 72 hours. The unwarranted attacks against U.S.
forces were not successful. The U.S. also says on Tuesday, the IRGC launched multiple ballistic
missiles from Iran in an attempted surprise attack on U.S. forces in the Middle East.
All of the missiles were intercepted. A U.S. official tells the Associated Press the two attacks
were not connected. The strikes, though, come on the same day that President Trump met with
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky.
Netanyahu insists he and President Trump are on the same page when it comes to the war.
Because the president is so clear. I mean, he's so—we have a common commitment. We don't want to see
this fanatic regime in Tehran have nuclear weapons to threaten every American and to threaten the
peace of the world and to threaten the existence of Israel. So we have a common goal. And it's going
to be achieved, either through diplomatic means or other means. But we're both committed to that.
